title: rulefit audit configuration
description: Describes where the audited tool keeps its file-type allowlist and its path-to-rule map, and where inside those files the data lives.

file.description: Path to the file holding the accepted file extensions, relative to --root.

selector.description: Dotted path to the JSON array of extensions. "[]" means the whole document is the array.

file.description: Path to the file holding the default rule and the path-to-rule map, relative to --root.

default_selector.description: Dotted path to the fallback rule name, for example "default_rule".

map_selector.description: Dotted path to the object whose keys are glob patterns and whose values are rule names.

docs_dir.description: Directory holding the rule documents, relative to --root. Omit to skip the reachability and missing-document checks.

ignore_extensions.description: Extensions that are expected to fall through to the default rule.

placeholder_extensions.description: Extensions whose allowlist entry exists only to satisfy a formatter or a compound extension.

ignore_patterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude from the collision check, for intentional overlaps.
